text:
I signed off with low confidence (0.4). Of the four bugs I reported, the developer confirmed one and said they could not reproduce the other three.

- **Confirmed:** the Subtasks row in the sort sheet shows a "Descending" toggle even when it is set to "My order", where a direction makes no sense.
- **Title sort Descending:** this was reported twice and not reproduced either time. With Grouping set to None, Sorting By title Descending left the list in ascending order: Buy milk, Pack for trip, Pay rent, Read docs. I saw it twice, and By due date Descending did reverse the list correctly.
- **Note link:** "See https://example.com/guide" in the Read docs notes looks like plain text. It has no link styling, and tapping it just put the cursor in the field. I never saw a browser open, and I did not check whether the link works in the task list.

Grouping by due date looked right: headings were "Due Thursday", "Due Tuesday, November 24", "Due Friday, December 4" and "No due date", and reversing the grouping direction worked. I did not test rotating the screen, a different date format, or the other sort options beyond title and due date.
